date_label: M. 1906; still married at the close of the source's account
summary: Five years after his first wife died, Marillier married Winifred Christabel Hopkins, daughter of the painter Arthur Hopkins and composer of 'The Rose and the Ring'. They had a son. He went on to run Morris & Co. And to become the authority on tapestry, and died in 1951.

sources.quote: he married in 1906 Winifred Christabel Hopkins, the daughter of the artist Arthur Hopkins. She was the composer of 'The Rose and the Ring'. They had one son.
sources.context: The Whistler Correspondence's biographical entry on H. C. Marillier, continuing from the sentence on his first wife's death in 1901. The elision drops a clause on the Hopkins family.
sources.supports: The second marriage, its year, the wife's identity and her own work.
sources.provenance: Whistler Correspondence biographical entry (Mari_HC), footnoted to Nevinson's DNB/ODNB article on Marillier (34876)
